title: Esquisse - Canvas
description: An Esquisse addon that adds an infinite canvas
body:
An addon for the Esquisse mod, adding an infinitely scalable canvas. All of the base mod's tools work on the canvas, additionally you can use ripped out sketchbook pages as stickers on the canvas.

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aaf02afb5f89aff9df5e6b61d40055825ae0e46c.png)

## Current addon controls:
### Canvas View
- Ctrl + mouse wheel on empty canvas: zoom canvas in/out
- Right-drag on empty canvas: pan/move around canvas
- Middle-drag: pan/move around canvas
- Space + left-drag: pan/move around canvas
  
### Paper Squares
Left-click ghost square/adjacent expansion area: add a new paper square
Requires paper in inventory

### Stickers
- Top-left sketched-page button: add a ripped sketchbook page as a sticker
- Right-click sticker: select and start dragging
- Right-drag selected sticker: move sticker
- Ctrl + mouse wheel while hovering a sticker: select and scale that sticker
- Ctrl + Shift + mouse wheel: scale currently selected sticker even if cursor is not over it
